summary: Shared docs for related modules go in a ModuleDocFragment class, included via extends_documentation_fragment with the FQCN. Only use fragments whose interface you fully implement; DOCUMENTATION is inserted by default and module values override fragment ones.
questions: How do I share option documentation across several modules?
What happens if my module and the doc fragment define the same option?
Can I use a doc fragment if my module only implements part of it?

answer_card.title: Documentation fragments
answer_card.answer_md:
Put shared docs in a `ModuleDocFragment` class in `lib/ansible/plugins/doc_fragments/` or a collection's `plugins/doc_fragments/`, and add `extends_documentation_fragment: kubernetes.core.k8s_auth_options` (FQCN).
- Only use a fragment if your module implements the whole interface identically.
- By default only its `DOCUMENTATION` property is inserted.
- Module values override fragment values.
